title: Bookkeeping Is Not Judgement: EJBench, an Engineering Judgement Benchmark Built from a Conjugate Heat Transfer Design Campaign
abstract: arXiv:2611.21707v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce EJBench, a benchmark of engineering judgement: whether a model can predict how a design behaves at new conditions from a few earlier results, and decide on it. Unlike engineering benchmarks that test whether an agent can operate simulation or CAD software, EJBench is software-agnostic and asks what an engineer would conclude without running a simulation. Its tasks come from a conjugate heat transfer design campaign for battery cold plates, in three families: matching unlabelled test results to their operating points, choosing which stored runs to reveal before signing off a design, and ranking new duties by peak cell temperature. Every answer is taken from a converged simulation, not from an LLM judge. The best of ten frontier models, GPT-6 Astra, scores 0.71, and models state almost the same confidence on tasks they get wrong as on tasks they get right. We also post-train Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA and reinforcement learning, r

translated_title: 记账不等于判断：EJBench——基于共轭传热设计活动构建的工程判断基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了EJBench，一个工程判断基准：考察模型能否从少量早期结果中预测设计在新工况下的表现，并据此做出决策。与那些测试智能体能否操作仿真或CAD软件的工程基准不同，EJBench与具体软件无关，考察的是工程师在不运行仿真的情况下会得出什么结论。其任务来自电池冷板的共轭传热设计活动，分为三类：将未标注的测试结果与其运行工况进行匹配、在签署设计之前选择应揭示哪些已存储的仿真运行结果、以及按峰值电芯温度对新任务进行排序。每个答案都取自收敛的仿真结果，而非LLM裁判。十个前沿模型中表现最好的GPT-6 Astra得分为0.71，且模型在答错的任务上所表达的置信度与答对的任务几乎相同。我们还使用LoRA和强化学习对Qwen3.5-9B进行了后训练……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出EJBench——一个基于电池冷板共轭传热设计活动构建的与软件无关的工程判断基准，考察模型能否从少量已有结果预测设计在新工况下的行为并做出决策，结果发现最佳前沿模型仅得0.71分，且模型答错时表达的置信度与答对时几乎相同。
en_tdlr: EJBench is a software-agnostic engineering judgement benchmark built from a battery cold plate conjugate heat transfer design campaign, testing whether models can predict design behavior at new conditions and make decisions from a few prior results; the best of ten frontier models scores only 0.71, and models state nearly the same confidence on tasks they get wrong as on those they get right.
